title: The CIG Journal
lede: CIG's Journal Club brings students and expert doctors together through interactive webinars to read, analyze, and discuss published cardiovascular research.
about: CIG's Journal Club hosts webinars with doctors and expert guest speakers to analyze and discuss already published cardiovascular research papers.

issues.title: Cardiology Webinar 1
issues.summary: Discussion on published research with expert doctors.
issues.abstract: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) may overcome key limitations of radiofrequency ablation (RFA) when treating premature ventricular contractions (PVCs) in anatomically complex regions (eg, left ventricular summit or intramural outflow tract [OT]). However, the safety and efficacy of PFA in OT PVCs remain to be determined.
keyFindings: Proceural efficiency and tissue selectivity of pulsed field abalation in ventricular arrhythmia managment
Identification of current clinical evidence gaps and future research directions for PVC ablation

sections.title: Journal club
sections.text: CIG's journal club meets through the academic year to read one cardiovascular paper properly: the question it asked, the design it chose, what the numbers actually show and what the paper does not establish. It is the training ground for everything the Journal publishes.

sections.title: From research to publication
sections.text: Projects that begin as a CIG research idea are written up by the students who ran them. If you have a question you would like to pursue, the research team is the place to start.
